title: Mailbox Deletion Warning
scenario: A campus IT email says your inbox will be deleted unless you log in through a link.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Mailbox Deletion Warning: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Never authenticate through links you did not request.
